name: Death Blossoms
blurb: Protect blossoming corpse flowers from the frenzied creatures of the forest.

stages.log_text: A grove of mutated corpse flowers is about to blossom, and the powerful odor will drive nearby creatures into a frenzy, causing them to attack the plants. The corpse flowers are a valuable source of useful ingredients, and we need to protect them until they can be harvested.

Driven into a frenzy by the powerful aroma of the blossoming corpse flowers, the creatures of the forest are attacking these rare plants. The corpse flowers are a valuable source of useful ingredients, and we need to protect them until they can be harvested.
